title: Square Machine
story: The workshop stamps out squares of the even numbers from 1 to 10.
goal: Create a list called squares with the squares of the even numbers from 1 to 10 (4, 16, 36, 64, 100).
hints: A loop with an if could build it. Python also has a one-line shortcut.
A list comprehension looks like [expression for item in items if condition].
socratic: What is done to each number that passes?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Square Machine”?
alt: squares = [n * n for n in range(1, 11) if n % 2 == 0]
